title: Was going to, was about to: dự định trong quá khứ
summary: Nói dự định, việc sắp xảy ra trong quá khứ: was going to, was about to, would; thường để kể kế hoạch không thành.

dialogue.en: Did you go to the beach last weekend?
dialogue.vi: Cuối tuần trước bạn đi biển không?

dialogue.en: We [[were going to]] go, but it rained.
dialogue.vi: Bọn mình định đi nhưng trời mưa.

dialogue.en: That's a shame. What did you do instead?
dialogue.vi: Tiếc thế. Thế bạn làm gì?

dialogue.en: I [[was about to]] call you, actually.
dialogue.vi: Thật ra lúc đó mình suýt gọi cho bạn.
Thật à? Sao bạn không gọi?

sections.heading: Was / were going to
sections.rule: **was/were going to + V** = **đã định** làm gì trong quá khứ. Thường dùng khi kế hoạch **không thành**.

examples.en: I [[was going to]] call you, but I forgot.
examples.vi: Tôi định gọi cho bạn nhưng quên mất.
examples.why: Dự định trong quá khứ, không thành.

examples.en: They [[were going to]] buy a car, but prices went up.
examples.vi: Họ định mua xe nhưng giá tăng.

check.prompt: We ___ go out, but it started raining.
check.explain: Dự định trong quá khứ → were going to.

sections.heading: Was about to
sections.rule: **was/were about to + V** = **sắp sửa** làm gì ngay lúc đó (thì có chuyện xảy ra).

examples.en: I [[was about to]] leave when the phone rang.
examples.vi: Tôi vừa định đi thì điện thoại reo.
examples.why: Sắp làm ngay lúc đó → was about to.

examples.en: The film [[was about to]] start, so we hurried.
examples.vi: Phim sắp chiếu nên chúng tôi vội vàng.

check.prompt: She ___ to cry when he finally said sorry.
check.explain: Sắp sửa ngay lúc đó → was about to.

sections.heading: Would: tương lai nhìn từ quá khứ
sections.rule: Trong câu kể hoặc câu gián tiếp, **will** đổi thành **would**: điều được dự đoán từ một thời điểm quá khứ.
body: *I knew she would win* = lúc đó tôi đã biết cô ấy sẽ thắng.

examples.en: I knew you [[would]] like this place.
examples.vi: Tôi biết bạn sẽ thích chỗ này mà.
examples.why: Dự đoán nhìn từ quá khứ → would.

examples.vi: Anh ấy hứa sẽ giúp tôi.

check.prompt: She said she ___ call me later.
check.explain: Kể lại từ quá khứ → would.

mistakes.wrong: I was going to called you.
mistakes.right: I was going to call you.
mistakes.why: Sau going to dùng V nguyên mẫu.

mistakes.wrong: I am going to go yesterday, but I was ill.
mistakes.right: I was going to go yesterday, but I was ill.
mistakes.why: Dự định trong quá khứ → was going to.

mistakes.wrong: I was about leaving when you came.
mistakes.right: I was about to leave when you came.

mistakes.wrong: I knew she will be angry.
mistakes.right: I knew she would be angry.

mistakes.wrong: They were going buy a house.
mistakes.right: They were going to buy a house.
mistakes.why: Thiếu to: were going to + V.

exercises.prompt: I ___ email you, but my laptop broke.
exercises.explain: Dự định trong quá khứ không thành.

exercises.prompt: We were about ___ dinner when the guests arrived.
I thought the test ___ be easy.
exercises.explain: Ý nghĩ trong quá khứ → would.

exercises.prompt: Câu nào nghĩa là kế hoạch KHÔNG thành?
options: We were going to go to Hue.
exercises.explain: Was going to thường nói kế hoạch không thành.

exercises.prompt: He ___ about to give up when he found the answer.
I ___ to buy that dress, but it was sold out.
They were ___ to close the shop when we came in.
exercises.explain: Were about to + V: sắp đóng cửa.

exercises.prompt: She told me she ___ be late.
exercises.explain: Kể lại từ quá khứ: will → would.

exercises.prompt: We were going to ___ a taxi, but we walked.
exercises.explain: Sau going to: V nguyên mẫu.

exercises.vi: Phim sắp chiếu thì chúng tôi đến.
alternatives: When we arrived the film was about to start.

exercises.sentence: I was going to visited my aunt.
answers: I was going to visit my aunt.
exercises.explain: Sau going to: V nguyên mẫu.

exercises.sentence: We are about to leave when it started to snow.
answers: We were about to leave when it started to snow.
exercises.explain: Kể quá khứ → were about to.

exercises.vi: Tôi định đi Đà Lạt nhưng không có thời gian.
answers: I was going to go to Da Lat, but I didn't have time.
I was going to go to Da Lat but I didn't have time.
I was going to go to Da Lat, but I had no time.
I was going to visit Da Lat, but I didn't have time.
I was going to travel to Da Lat, but I didn't have time.
exercises.explain: Dự định không thành → was going to.

exercises.vi: Tôi vừa định ra ngoài thì trời mưa.
answers: I was about to go out when it rained.
I was about to go out when it started to rain.
I was about to go out when it started raining.
I was about to leave when it rained.
I was about to leave when it started to rain.
I was about to go out when it began to rain.
exercises.explain: Sắp làm thì bị cắt ngang → was about to.
